differences.what: The section shows when the pregnancy test is Positive, or when the flag Known pregnancy, no test today (sexrepro-1, beside the test) is set: a pregnancy known before this visit is charted without a test being recorded that was not done. The flag is a departure from the lines.
differences.why: inventory A44; PRD main 417 (once a pregnancy is confirmed); PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): whether a known pregnancy opens the section, for the clinical team to confirm

differences.what: Gestational age is a duration: weeks and days, stored as days, bounded at 45 weeks (315 days), so a slip such as 400 weeks for 40 is refused.
differences.why: forms 2.3 (a duration's max); PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #19): the range of gestational age, 0 to 45 weeks, for the clinical team

differences.what: A date, past or future: a pregnancy that runs past its due date keeps a due date in the past.
differences.why: inventory construct 16; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): the date's range

differences.what: Gravida is a whole number, 1 to 30.
differences.why: PRD main 420; inventory A47; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): the range

differences.what: Para is a whole number of its own, 0 to 30.
differences.why: PRD main 420; inventory A47; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): the range

differences.what: Other is written as a heading over its text box (added): it asks for a short text.
